## Episode Thesis

This is a macro episode with Nordea chief economist Annika Winsth. It discusses September CPIF inflation of 1.5% and core inflation, which came in lower than expected. Winsth still expects the Riksbank to raise its policy rate from 1.75% in November and again in February, with a possible further hike depending on the ECB. She cites a strong economy, a weak krona, energy prices and temporary tax cuts that hold inflation down. Her view is broadly positive: households are much better prepared than in 2022, all regions are doing well, especially those tied to the defence industry, and the labour market should improve. No listed equities are discussed with a directional view.
